mentions.name: Audio FPAA ASIC
mentions.description: An audio field-programmable analog array (FPAA) ASIC being prepared for the Wafer Space run 3 chip fabrication shuttle. Circuit blocks are partially validated ahead of the tapeout deadline, and a two-edge pad ring design from the prior run could enable significant die area savings.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still working on my audio FPAA ASIC for Wafer Space run 3!
mentions.author: Archit3ch
